title_en: A Cruise Through the Three Gorges
note_en: In comparisons with 比, adding 更 or 还 before the adjective means "even more": 坐船看三峡比坐飞机更让人印象深刻 "seeing the Three Gorges by boat was even more impressive than flying." Unlike English, Chinese never uses 很 or 非常 inside a 比 comparison; to say "much more," put 得多 after the adjective instead: 比现在差得多 "much worse than now."
